description.value: Royston General Store is a convenience and general store on the South Island Highway in the small coastal community of Royston, operated by the Wayne Procter Group, a multi-division Vancouver Island retail company. It sits on a key cycling corridor connecting Courtenay and Comox to points south, making it a natural resupply stop for touring cyclists on this stretch of the Island. The operator runs a network of similar general stores across Vancouver Island under its Omni Foods and Gas N Go umbrella.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Royston General is a real, operating general/convenience store at 3922 Island Hwy, Royston, run by The Wayne Procter Group. OSM tags add phone, payment methods, and confirm shop=convenience. No cycling-specific amenity information (bike parking, water, washrooms, etc.) appears anywhere in the website content, so those are all null. Minor spelling discrepancy noted between OSM operator tag ('Proctor') and website ('Procter').
